name: @cloudsforge/agora
description: Forge Agora. The ecosystem's public square: voices, posts, replies, quotes, echoes, sparks, follows, circles, tags, whispers, notifications and moderation. Reverse-chronological only — there is no ranked feed, and no audience count is ever public.

scripts._test: --test-concurrency=1 is required, not a preference: every database test file truncates this service's tables between cases, and node:test runs FILES in parallel by default. A TRUNCATE takes an AccessExclusiveLock, so one file's reset deadlocks against another file's inserts (40P01). The ledger learned this the hard way, market copied it, and this service copied market. Cases within a file already run in order.
scripts._test_glob: node:test does not recurse. Every mounted module's suites must be named explicitly or they silently do not run — and `skipped 0` would not say so, because node:test does not count cases inside a describe it never loaded.
scripts.test: node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 src/*.test.ts src/devplatform/*.test.ts src/policy/*.test.ts src/pricing/*.test.ts src/studio/*.test.ts src/community/*.test.ts src/market/*.test.ts src/billing/*.test.ts src/mint/*.test.ts src/foresight/*.test.ts src/worlds/*.test.ts src/tessera/*.test.ts src/activity/*.test.ts src/activity/notify/*.test.ts src/lantern/*.test.ts src/lantern/analytics/*.test.ts src/hub/*.test.ts src/trade/*.test.ts src/wallet/*.test.ts src/admin/*.test.ts src/emberkin/*.test.ts src/emberkin/aetherholm/*.test.ts src/emberkin/nda/*.test.ts

_localDependencies: Every sibling takes 'link:', not 'file:'. A 'file:' path PACKS the dependency, and each of
these packages declares files: ['dist'] with a publishConfig that points main/types at dist/.
Packing therefore installs a package whose exports resolve to a dist/ that has not been built,
while its 'main' in the working tree still says src/index.ts. 'link:' symlinks the checkout in
place, so the working-tree manifest is the one that is read.
